about: What this member said on the floor, from the Congressional Record: their own words only, and of those the sentences that name an alignment question's phrases or make a commitment. Written by npm run record:collect (scripts/collect-record.mjs).
name: Laura Gillen

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: COUNTERING IRAN'S AGGRESSION AND PROTECTING OUR COUNTRY
statements.title: COUNTERING IRAN'S AGGRESSION AND PROTECTING OUR COUNTRY
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise today to condemn the Iranian regime as it threatens the United States and our ally Israel.
Iran is the world's leading state sponsor of terror, bankrolling the heinous terrorist groups Hamas, Hezbollah, and the Houthis.
The regime and its proxies seek to destroy America and Israel and wreak havoc across the Middle East.
Let me be clear: Iran can never be allowed to obtain nuclear weapons, and the United States must always be prepared to act to prevent a nuclear-armed Iran.
Mr. Speaker, I hope the administration will come to Congress with a plan and work with us to counter Iran's aggression and protect our country. ____________________

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: AMENDMENT NO. 1 OFFERED BY MR. MASSIE
statements.title: AMENDMENT NO. 1 OFFERED BY MR. MASSIE
sentences: Mr. Chair, I rise in strong opposition to this amendment.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: COAST GUARD AUTHORIZATION ACT OF 2025
statements.title: COAST GUARD AUTHORIZATION ACT OF 2025
sentences: Madam Speaker, I rise in support of H.R. 4275, the bipartisan Coast Guard Authorization Act of 2025, which includes my provision to improve navigation in the East Rockaway Inlet off the South Shore of Long Island and to strengthen maritime drug enforcement in our waters.

I am especially glad that this legislation includes a commonsense, bipartisan bill I cosponsored with my Republican colleague from North Carolina, Representative Addison McDowell, to help the Coast Guard respond to opioid overdoses.
Madam Speaker, in closing, I urge all of my colleagues to join me in supporting this important bill.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF SENATE AMENDMENT TO H.R. 1, ONE BIG BEAUTIFUL BILL ACT
statements.title: PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF SENATE AMENDMENT TO H.R. 1, ONE BIG BEAUTIFUL BILL ACT
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I ask unanimous consent to amend the rule to make in order the amendment at the desk that protects against any cuts to Medicaid and SNAP.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: MOMENT OF SILENCE IN MEMORY OF THE HONORABLE CAROLYN McCARTHY
statements.title: MOMENT OF SILENCE IN MEMORY OF THE HONORABLE CAROLYN McCARTHY
sentences: Carolyn was a tireless advocate for the South Shore of Nassau County on Long Island and a fearless champion in the fight against gun violence.
She ran for Congress as a mother, a nurse, and a voice for families devastated by the senseless scourge of gun violence.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: MEDICAID IS A LIFELINE
statements.title: MEDICAID IS A LIFELINE
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise today to raise the alarm on Senate Republicans' plan to rip Medicaid from 1.5 million New Yorkers, including children, seniors, and veterans on Long Island.
Mr. Speaker, Medicaid is not a luxury.
In Nassau County, one in four children depend on Medicaid for their healthcare, and two in three seniors in nursing homes are covered by Medicaid.
Slashing Medicaid means ripping healthcare from the youngest, the oldest, and the special needs communities, the most vulnerable members of our community.
Once again, we have been clearly warned: The Medicaid cuts in the budget bill will have devastating impacts on our healthcare system and on millions of Americans who depend on it.
I am committed to fighting against these dangerous attempts to attack Long Islanders' healthcare. ____________________

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: RESCISSION PACKAGE
statements.title: RESCISSION PACKAGE
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise today to address the cruel rescission package that passed the House strictly on partisan lines.
The American people have been clear that they want Congress to lower costs and make life easier for working families.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: CONDEMNING THE BOULDER, COLORADO, ANTI-SEMITIC ATTACK
statements.title: CONDEMNING THE BOULDER, COLORADO, ANTI-SEMITIC ATTACK
sentences: This horrific attack comes on the heels of another targeted anti- Semitic terror attack at the Capital Jewish Museum here in Washington, D.C., where a hate-filled gunman murdered two young employees of the Israeli Embassy, Yaron and Sarah.
As a Member of Congress, I will continue to fight for policies that confront anti-Semitism, extremism, and hate wherever it is found. ____________________

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: NATIONAL POLICE WEEK
statements.title: NATIONAL POLICE WEEK
sentences: Mr. Speaker, in recognition of National Police Week, and on behalf of New York's Fourth Congressional District, I am proud to stand here today to honor our brave men and women in law enforcement.
When disaster strikes and people are in need, our law enforcement officers are the first to respond.
Without law enforcement, we would not enjoy the security we often take for granted.

Among them are Officers Erick Contreras, Christopher Cizmarik, Kevin Canavan, and Philip Schifini of the Nassau County Police Department who bravely served our community on 9/11, one of the darkest days in American history.

Unfortunately, thousands of our heroic law enforcement officers, firefighters, and emergency personnel who bravely answered the call on the darkest day in our Nation's history continue to suffer from life- threatening cancers, respiratory diseases, and other debilitating conditions from the toxins at Ground Zero.
In just 3 years on the force, Detective Diller made over 70 arrests and was honored with three Excellent Police Duty medals.
As we mark Police Week, may God bless the officers who gave up their lives to keep Americans safe and may He give their loved ones comfort.
On behalf of all of Long Island, we will never forget those who laid down their lives in service to others.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: BRING BACK FULL SALT DEDUCTIBILITY
statements.title: BRING BACK FULL SALT DEDUCTIBILITY
sentences: I will continue to explore every possible avenue to do just that. ____________________

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: ELIMINATE THE SALT CAP
statements.title: ELIMINATE THE SALT CAP
sentences: I will continue to push for a full repeal of this cap, and I urge my colleagues on both sides of the aisle to do the same.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: ASSAULT ON REPRODUCTIVE FREEDOM
statements.title: ASSAULT ON REPRODUCTIVE FREEDOM
sentences: Mr. Speaker, in the 2 years since the Dobbs decision, we have seen nothing short of an all-out assault on our reproductive rights and our reproductive freedoms, including a steady march to pass a national abortion ban coupled with efforts to roll back access to contraception and IVF.
It is truly shocking that in 2025, we have to defend Americans' access to birth control and ability to decide when they start a family, but the attacks on reproductive freedom keep coming.
That means making sure that the right to access to contraception is codified into law.
I am proud to cosponsor H.R. 999, the Right to Contraception Act.
I will continue to fight to defend women's and families' freedom to make their own personal healthcare decisions.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: HALT ALL LETHAL TRAFFICKING OF FENTANYL ACT
statements.title: HALT ALL LETHAL TRAFFICKING OF FENTANYL ACT
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise today as a proud cosponsor of H.R. 27, the HALT Fentanyl Act.
It is time we take on the cartels and hold traffickers accountable.
The DEA, the Fraternal Order of Police, and countless other law enforcement groups have said the HALT Fentanyl Act will save lives and improve public safety.
I am proud to support this bipartisan bill today, and I urge my colleagues on both sides of the aisle to join me in that.
I also urge my colleagues on the other side of the aisle to find ways that we can work together to make better bills.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: WELCOMING HOME ROMI GONEN, EMILY DAMARI, AND DORON STEINBRECHER
statements.title: WELCOMING HOME ROMI GONEN, EMILY DAMARI, AND DORON STEINBRECHER
sentences: We must always stand with our ally, Israel. ____________________
We will not rest until every hostage comes home.
We will never forget October 7, the single deadliest day for the Jewish people since the Holocaust.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: BORN-ALIVE ABORTION SURVIVORS PROTECTION ACT
statements.title: BORN-ALIVE ABORTION SURVIVORS PROTECTION ACT
sentences: Since the disastrous Dobbs decision, we have seen nothing short of an all-out assault on women's reproductive rights and freedoms.
I know this firsthand because when I was supposed to be thrilled by a 20-week sonogram, I got the devastating news that my daughter had no heartbeat.
I needed to have an emergency abortion procedure to ensure that I could live to raise my two children already at home.
Americans want Congress to lower costs, secure our border, and create jobs; not interfere with heartbreaking family medical decisions.
Mr. Speaker, I rise in strong opposition to this bill.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: THESE ISSUES AREN'T POLITICAL
statements.title: THESE ISSUES AREN'T POLITICAL
sentences: We need to address the cost-of-living crisis, secure our border, and give hardworking Long Islanders a middle-class tax cut by reinstating the full SALT tax deduction.

I am honored to be their Congresswoman, and I look forward to working with anyone from any party who is serious about working productively to address the pressing issues that our working families face. ____________________
